product_hero_content.product_hero_content_title: What is the Portugal Golden Visa?

product_hero_content_text.product_hero_content_text_item: The Portugal Golden Visa is a residency-by-investment program for investors who hold citizenship outside the European Union.
You and your family receive a Portuguese residence permit once you meet the program's investment requirement.
Your whole family has access to healthcare, education, and social security in Portugal on the terms set by law.
As a Golden Visa holder, you and your family travel visa-free within the 29 countries of the Schengen Area.
After 10 years of holding the Golden Visa and meeting the investment and residence conditions, you can file for Portuguese citizenship under the nationality rules in force at the time.
The usual route is a fund investment from €500,000; some other routes start at €250,000.

acf.product_benefits_title: Benefits of the Portugal Golden Visa

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Your whole family can live, work, and study in Portugal.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: Visa-free travel in the Schengen Area

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Travel across the 29 Schengen countries under the standard short-stay rule: 90 days in any 180-day period.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: The same benefits as local residents

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Access to Portugal's health and education systems on the same terms as local residents.
You can apply for naturalization after 10 years if you meet the conditions.
Visa-free or eVisa access to 189 countries, including the United Kingdom, the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and other major countries.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: A route to the US E-2 visa

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: Once you hold Portuguese citizenship and have at least 3 continuous years of residence in Portugal, you may be eligible to apply for a US E-2 investor visa.

product_benefits_items.product_benefits_item_title: The right to live anywhere in the EU

product_benefits_item_bullets.product_benefits_item_bullet_text: With Portuguese citizenship, your family has the right to live in any EU country.

acf.product_advantages_title: Why investors choose the Portugal Golden Visa

product_advantages_item_bullets.product_advantages_item_bullet_text: You need to spend an average of just 14 days in Portugal every 2 years to keep your Golden Visa
Among the lighter stay requirements of the European programs.
You can be considered for citizenship after 10 years if you meet the conditions
Among the European residency-by-investment programs with a more accessible route to citizenship.
One of the few programs that allows children of any age to be included
The condition is that they are unmarried and financially dependent on you.
No degree or management experience is required.

product_conditions_item_bullets.product_conditions_item_bullet_text: Aged 18 or older, with no upper age limit
Meets security and background vetting requirements
You document a lawful source of funds for the investment
Children, including adopted children, who are unmarried and financially dependent — with no age limit
Parents of both spouses; those under 65 must show they are financially dependent on you
Siblings under 18 who are financially dependent on you
You choose one of the qualifying investment routes:
Fund investment: €500,000 into a qualifying Portuguese investment fund, held for at least 5 years.

A qualifying fund is registered in Portugal, has been running for more than 5 years, invests at least 60% of its capital in commercial companies based in Portugal, and does not invest directly or indirectly in real estate.
Scientific research: an investment of at least €500,000.
Arts and cultural heritage projects: a non-refundable donation of at least €250,000.
Company formation: an investment of at least €500,000 that creates 5 jobs, or forming a new company that creates 10 jobs.
Real estate: the property ownership route, which started at €280,000, has been closed since October 2023.

product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: Sign the deposit agreement and complete the initial due diligence on your file.
The service agreement for your Golden Visa application and the subscription agreement with the fund.

product_process_steps.product_process_step_title: Prepare the file and transfer the investment
product_process_steps.product_process_step_desc: We prepare your file and you transfer the investment under the route you have chosen.
File the application with AIMA, Portugal's immigration and asylum agency.
Receive pre-approval, then travel to Portugal to provide your biometrics.

You receive formal approval and the residence permit is sent to you in your home country.
The permit runs for 2 years and is renewed in cycles as long as you keep the investment and meet the stay requirement of 14 days every 2 years.
Actual processing depends on your file and on AIMA's own timelines; IMM Group sets out the likely timeline for your case.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How is the investment structured?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The Portugal Golden Visa has several qualifying investment routes

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Fund investment — from €500,000, the route most investors take today.
Scientific research — from €500,000.
Arts and cultural heritage — a non-refundable donation from €250,000.
Forming or investing in a company — from €500,000, with job creation conditions.
The real estate route has been closed since October 2023. The amounts and conditions that apply are those in force when you apply. (Updated: June 2026.)

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is a Golden Visa, and how does it differ from permanent residence?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: What the Golden Visa is, and how it differs from permanent residence

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The Portugal Golden Visa is a long-term residence permit for investors. In day-to-day terms it gives your family much of what permanent residence does: you can live, work, start a business, and put your children through school in Portugal.
The difference: the Golden Visa runs for a fixed term and has to be renewed periodically. After 10 years of residence, you can be considered for citizenship if you qualify.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What about Schengen and the EU?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Short stays in the Schengen Area — not a right to live or work elsewhere in the EU

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The Golden Visa allows travel within the Schengen Area under the short-stay rules of 90 days in any 180-day period.
Travel to EU countries outside the Schengen Area still requires a visitor visa, though such applications are usually given priority.
The right to live, work, and study in any EU country arises only once you hold Portuguese citizenship.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Schengen is not the same as the EU

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The EU — the European Union: an intergovernmental organization of 27 countries.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The Schengen Area is a zone where you can travel freely between the 29 member countries.
Some EU countries are not in Schengen, and the reverse is also true. Portugal is a member of both.
So a Golden Visa already allows short trips within the Schengen Area; the right to live and work across the EU arises only with citizenship.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Do my children study free of charge?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Free schooling for your children

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: While your family holds a valid Golden Visa, your children attend Portugal's public schools free of charge, from primary through the end of secondary school.
At university level, tuition and any support available depend on the institution and on your child's residence status at enrollment.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is income earned outside Portugal taxed?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Tax on income earned outside Portugal

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Portuguese income tax applies only once you become a tax resident — generally when you spend more than 183 days a year in Portugal.
Investors who visit only as long as they need to in order to keep or renew the permit usually fall outside that.
Tax policy can change, and your own position should be confirmed with a tax advisor at the time you apply. (Updated: June 2026.)

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are my options after 5 years?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Your options after 5 years

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: After 5 years of holding the Golden Visa you have 3 options: keep renewing the residence permit; apply for permanent residence
If you keep renewing, you have to maintain the investment. If you apply for permanent residence or citizenship, once you qualify, you are no longer required to keep the investment.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the requirements for citizenship?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: To be considered for Portuguese citizenship you need

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: To be 18 or older;
To have held a valid Golden Visa for at least 10 years, meeting the stay requirement of an average of 14 days every 2 years;
To reach level A2 in Portuguese;
And to have no criminal record in Portugal or abroad.
Applications are assessed under the rules in force at the time you apply.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the A2 Portuguese exam?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The language requirement is a Portuguese certificate at CEFR level A2.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The exam can be run by an accredited school in Portugal or in another Portuguese-speaking country, by IEFP, Portugal's public employment and training institute, or by an accredited test center.
A2 is a basic level; comparisons with IELTS are indicative only.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is an online certificate accepted?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Online certificates

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Under the rules, you and your family members need a certificate of completion from a Portuguese course at a public school in Portugal, or at a licensed center in Portugal.
Whether an online course is accepted depends on the rules in force — check before you enroll.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What does Portuguese citizenship give you?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: What citizenship gives you

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Full Portuguese citizenship rights, including the right to live, work, and study in any EU country.
The Portuguese passport is among the stronger ones, with visa-free or eVisa access to a wide range of countries (the number changes over time).
Once you hold Portuguese citizenship and have 3 or more continuous years of residence in Portugal, you can explore the US E-2 route under the E-2 rules in force at the time.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What are the investment risks?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The investment risks

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The two main risks: choosing a project or fund without a solid track record, or one that does not qualify under the program; and investment capital from an unlawful source, which leads to the application being refused.
IMM Group reviews your file and the project in detail before any contract is signed, to limit these risks.

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_note: Note: a fund investment carries risk; returns and the recovery of your capital depend on how the fund performs.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What source of funds evidence is required?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Documenting your source of funds

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Documenting your source of funds for the Portugal Golden Visa is generally simpler than for programs such as the United States, Australia, or Canada — you show a lawful source at a basic level of detail, for example a property sale, income, or a business.
Every family documents this differently — contact IMM Group for advice on your own situation.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How long is the permit valid, and how is it renewed?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Validity and renewal

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The first Golden Visa permit runs for 2 years and can be renewed, usually for a further 3 years in the next cycle, provided you still hold the investment and have a clean criminal record.
After 5 years, if you qualify, you can apply for permanent residence. The validity and renewal cycles follow the rules in force at the time of renewal.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Is there an age limit for applicants?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The Portugal Golden Visa sets no upper age limit for the applicant.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You need only be 18 or older and meet the requirements on background checks and a lawful source of funds.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Are qualifications or language skills required?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Qualifications and language

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: At the investment stage the program requires no qualifications, no management experience, no proof of language ability, and no interview.
The requirement for Portuguese at level A2 applies later, at the citizenship stage.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Which family members can be included?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The Golden Visa lets you include a multigenerational family in a single application

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Your legal spouse;
Children, including adopted children, who are unmarried and financially dependent;
Parents of both spouses, where those under 65 show they are financially dependent on you;
And siblings under 18 who are financially dependent on you.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Are adopted children and stepchildren eligible?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The program allows adopted children and stepchildren to be included in their parents' application.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: An adopted child needs a legal adoption certificate.
A stepchild needs legal documents plus a notarized letter of consent from the spouse allowing the child to join the application.
IMM Group assists with preparing the documents.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: What is the age limit for dependent children?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The age limit for dependent children

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The program sets no hard upper age limit for dependent children — a child can be included if they are unmarried and financially dependent on you, which usually means they are in full-time study.
This is one of the advantages of the Portugal Golden Visa over many other programs. The exact conditions follow the rules in force.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can parents be included?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Parents in the application

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: Parents of both you and your spouse can be included. Parents aged 65 or older can join
Those under 65 need to show they are financially dependent on you.
The exact conditions follow the rules in force when you apply.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: How many days a year must I spend in Portugal?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: The Portugal Golden Visa does not require continuous residence.

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: To keep and renew the permit you need only meet the minimum stay requirement — an average of about 7 days a year, or 14 days every 2 years.
If you plan to apply for citizenship later, you will also need to meet the residence, language, and integration conditions set by law.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can I sell or exit the investment after 5 years?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Selling or exiting after 5 years

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: The real estate route has been closed since October 2023, so investors now qualify mainly through a fund.
You need to hold the fund investment continuously for at least 5 years.

product_faq_items.product_faq_item_question: Can I switch to a different fund?

product_faq_item_sections.product_faq_item_section_heading: Switching your fund investment

product_faq_item_section_bullets.product_faq_item_section_bullet_text: You need to hold a qualifying investment continuously throughout the required period.
Any switch between funds must keep the holding period unbroken and follow the program rules.
Questions about buying or selling real estate no longer apply, because that route is closed.
